A series of national surveys suggest Democrats currently hold an advantage on the generic congressional ballot, while President Donald Trump's approval ratings remain underwater in several prominent polls.



## What do the latest Trump approval polls show?

RealClearPolling shows Trump with a 40.7% approval rating average and a net approval rating of minus 17 percentage points. Another polling tracker highlighted a recent Economist/YouGov survey showing 39% approval and 59% disapproval. [...] The generic congressional ballot asks voters whether they would support the Democratic or Republican candidate for Congress in their district, regardless of who the candidates are.
